description: This file defines a custom exception class `LoanProductCannotBeModifiedDueToNonClosedLoansException` used in the loan product domain to signal that a loan product cannot be modified because there are open (non-closed) loans associated with it.

classes.name: LoanProductCannotBeModifiedDueToNonClosedLoansException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException to indicate that a loan product cannot be modified due to existing non-closed loans.

methods.name: LoanProductCannotBeModifiedDueToNonClosedLoansException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message key, a detailed message including the loan product ID, and the ID itself.

calls: super("error.msg.loanproduct.not.modifiable.due.to.non.closed.loans", "Loan product with identifier " + id + " cannot be modified due to non closed loans associated with it.", id)
